pages.title: Scribble Slash
pages.creator: blueLollipop
pages.description:
Scribble Slash turns drawings into attacks against waves of monsters on a notebook page. Hold and drag with the mouse or a finger to draw, slashing through enemies with a swipe or gathering a group inside a circle. Different shapes produce different effects: a zigzag calls lightning, a spiral creates a tornado, and a triangle forms a shield. Tap to set off an ink bomb.

Choose power cards as you level up and take on bosses including the Paint Golem, Spider Queen, and Ink Dragon. New worlds bring more of the scribbled enemies to fight. Keep choosing the right drawing for the crowd around you and survive for as long as you can. Press P to pause.

pages.title: Geometry Tower Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Geometry Tower Defense is a strategy game about keeping enemy waves from breaking through to your base. Place geometric towers at useful positions along the winding routes, then spend gold to improve the defenses you need most. You can upgrade towers or sell them as your plan changes. Use the game speed controls to manage the pace of the action while you watch for gaps in your coverage and prepare for another wave.

pages.title: Capybara Jump
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Capybara Jump is a stacking game about helping a capybara climb as blocks slide in from either side. Tap to jump and land on the moving block, adding another layer beneath the animal. Well timed landings build combos and increase your score, while a mistimed leap can send the capybara falling. Watch which side the next block comes from and choose the moment to jump as the tower grows.

pages.title: Wild West Match 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Wild West Match 3 is a tile swapping puzzle with a Western setting. Exchange neighboring pieces to create a horizontal or vertical line of at least three matching items, clearing them from the board. Work toward the current level's targets while keeping track of your remaining moves. Each cleared match changes the arrangement, so consider which swap will both help the objective and set up useful pieces for the next turn.

pages.title: Triple Cups
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Triple Cups is a color matching puzzle about flipping cups from the top area onto a stand below. Choose a position that puts at least three cups of the same color in a row. Matching cups disappear, award points, and leave room for another placement. The goal bar shows how many cups of each color you still need to collect. Plan your placements around those targets while keeping useful positions on the stand available.

pages.title: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator is a vehicle destruction game with crash tests, demolition derbies, and sandbox play. Drive cars into impacts and see how the vehicles respond as you experiment with different collisions.

Use WASD to drive and Space for the handbrake. The right mouse button rotates the camera, C changes the view, and B lets you look back. Additional vehicle controls include H for the horn, J for hazard lights, and Z or X for the turn signals. Touch devices use the controls displayed in the game.

pages.title: Color Maze
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Color Maze is a movement puzzle about lighting every path on a map. Use WASD or the arrow keys to guide your route through the maze, avoiding obstacles and considering which paths still need to be covered. Be careful about entering corners that can leave you stuck. Work through 20 increasingly difficult levels, checking the whole layout before choosing your next direction.

pages.title: Daddy Cactus
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Daddy Cactus puts you in control of a giant cactus gathering meat in a 3D world. Collect pieces scattered around the map and gather more from the people you encounter. Once your cargo is full, bring the load back to Mommy Cactus to make a delivery. Cannons and other obstacles make the trip more dangerous. Keep an eye on your cargo and the route back as you alternate between gathering another load and delivering it.

pages.title: Pumpkin Catcher
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description: Pumpkin Catcher is a Halloween jetpack game about gathering pumpkins while staying clear of rotating traps. Fly between the walls using a short tap for a brief burst or holding for a longer flight. Choose a character such as a zombie, vampire, devil, or cat, then work on collecting more pumpkins in each attempt. Judge the length of each burst carefully to move around the traps and keep the run going.

pages.title: Zombie Royale Io
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Zombie Royale Io is a survival game about rescuing survivors while fighting off zombies. Bring more people into your group and shoot the undead as the danger grows over time. Stronger zombies arrive and chase the remaining survivors, making the rescue harder to sustain. You can summon additional soldiers and bombs during play. After a round, spend collected gold coins on survivor upgrades to prepare your group for another attempt.

pages.title: Digital Circus IO
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description:
Digital Circus IO is a territory claiming game set in a circus arena. Choose a character, move out from your starting area, and return to it to capture the space you have enclosed. Watch the other competitors as you expand: crossing an opponent's trail defeats them, so exposed paths are part of both attack and defense.

On a computer, guide the character with the mouse, WASD, or the arrow keys. On a touch screen, tap in the direction you want to travel. Keep returning to your territory as you work to claim more of the arena.

pages.title: Hole Defense
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Hole Defense is a castle defense game about keeping approaching enemies away from your people. Dig holes, recruit soldiers, and improve your defenses to hold the attackers back. Special abilities add other ways to handle a crowded approach, including aircraft attacks, lava rocks, bombs from balloon bombers, and freezing effects. Choose how to combine those tools with your soldiers and upgrades as you protect the castle from capture.

pages.title: Zombie Frontier Shooter
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Zombie Frontier Shooter is a zombie action game about defending your territory against an undead horde. Drag to move your character through the area and take on the zombies threatening the survivors. Keep repositioning as you fight, watching where the enemies are gathering before choosing your next move. The task is to eliminate the approaching zombies and keep the defense going.

pages.title: City defense 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: City defense 2 is a crowd defense game about stopping an incoming group from taking over the city. Draw a defensive line and call in police and soldiers to hold the approach. Build up your force as you try to keep the crowd away from the area you are protecting. Use the mouse or touch controls to organize the defense and respond as more opponents move forward.

pages.title: Find 5 Differences Home
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find 5 Differences Home presents two nearly identical house pictures and asks you to find five changes between them. Compare the images side by side, looking closely at the objects and small details in each scene. Click or tap the differences you find until you have identified all five. Work on spotting them more quickly as you become familiar with checking each part of a picture.

pages.title: Ocho
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Ocho is a card game about emptying your hand ahead of the other players. Choose cards that match the current color or number and keep looking for opportunities to play the cards you are holding. Click a card to select it from your stack. Classic mode supports two to eight players, and team mode offers group competition. Plan your choices around the cards available as you try to be first to clear your hand.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pop it Now!
pages.creator: Gismart
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Pop it Now! is a color matching shooting game about clearing groups of bubbles. Drag to aim at the bubble arrangement, then release to fire your current bubble. Join at least three of the same color to pop the group and build your score. Look for placements that can remove more bubbles with a shot, and use the available boosters to help with the board.

pages.title: Football Master
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Football Master is a football shooting game in which you take on rival teams across several cities. Swipe to draw the path of your kick and set its power, then try to send the ball into the goal. Adjust the direction and strength for each attempt as you work on your finishing. Score against the opposition and keep progressing through the different city challenges.

pages.title: Celebrity Gala Prep
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Celebrity Gala Prep is a dress-up game about preparing celebrity characters for a gala party. Browse their wardrobes and choose an outfit for each guest, then add accessories to complete the look. Use the left mouse button to select the fashion items and compare different combinations. Put together a set of party styles for the group before the celebration.

pages.title: Teris Crush
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Teris Crush is a block placement puzzle about filling complete rows and columns. Drag the wooden shapes onto the board and arrange them so a horizontal or vertical line has no gaps. A completed line disappears and opens space for more blocks. The pieces cannot be rotated, so consider how each shape fits before placing it. Keep clearing lines to leave room for the next arrangement.

pages.title: Who is Daddy
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Who is Daddy follows a pregnant character collecting clues to identify the right father. Use the mouse to guide her, gather the clues, and pick up milk bottles for the baby. The game's route also asks you to avoid pizza, burger, and cola pickups. Watch what lies ahead and choose a path that reaches the useful items as you work toward identifying the correct character.

pages.title: Destroy Blocks
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Destroy Blocks is an arcade shooting game about matching the colors of a ball and incoming blocks. Blue and red blocks fall from above, and a shot can break a block only when its color matches. Change the ball's color as the targets change, using blue shots for blue blocks and red shots for red ones. Keep watching the falling pattern and reacting before the next color reaches you.

pages.title: Switch
pages.creator: Alex White
pages.description: Switch is a reaction game about catching falling balls with a matching colored platform. Click or tap to change the platform's color before the next ball reaches it. A correct match breaks the ball and adds to your score, while a collision with the wrong color ends the round. Watch the approaching colors and time your switches to keep the matching run going.

pages.title: Redball Another world
pages.creator: IceSky
pages.description:
Redball Another world is a 3D platform adventure about guiding a red ball to the end of each level. Move around obstacles, jump through the course, and deal with the opponents in your path. The game contains 15 levels spread across three worlds and records your best result.

Use WASD to move and Space to jump on a computer. Touch controls provide a movement stick on the left and a jump button on the right. Judge the next landing as you work toward each level's finish.

pages.title: Simon Say
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Simon Say is a sequence memory game built around tones and flashing lights. Watch and listen to the pattern, then repeat it in the same order using the mouse or touch controls. A successful response leads to a longer, more complex sequence. Keep track of every step as the pattern grows, because repeating it incorrectly ends the game.

pages.title: Let amoung us love
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Let amoung us love is a physics puzzle about sending a blue character to meet a pink partner. Drag to aim a launch, then release to send the character through the scene. Gravity effects can pull or push the flight path, while paired teleports move the character between locations. Plan a route that uses those effects and avoids the solid obstacles between the two characters.

pages.title: Jewel Miner
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Jewel Miner is a click-to-clear puzzle about reaching a score target on each level. Select a group of at least two matching jewels to remove them. Larger groups award more points for each jewel, so compare the clusters before choosing one to clear. Keep working toward the required score and move on once you have earned enough points.

pages.title: Power Ball
pages.creator: Pavel Tomcsanyi
pages.description:
Power Ball is an energy collection and defense game centered on a charging port. Click a destination to move the ball, collect energy points, and bring power back to the port in the middle. Enemy energy threatens your progress, and defensive discharges give you a way to protect the ball. Charging the port earns points for improving it and unlocking additional protection functions.

Use the red button at the lower right for charging and defensive discharges, or press Space on a computer. Unlocked auxiliary functions use the three buttons on the left or the number row keys 1, 2, and 3. The yellow meter shows stored energy, while the blue meter tracks your defensive discharge supply.

pages.title: Crazy Shooter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Crazy Shooter is a shooting game fought from windows against armed stickman enemies. Fire back at the targets and change windows to avoid their bullets. Keep choosing a position that lets you attack while staying out of the incoming shots. The shop offers equipment improvements to help with later encounters. Use the click controls to take on the opponents and develop your gear.

pages.title: Atari Missile Command
pages.creator: Atari
pages.description:
Atari Missile Command puts six cities under attack and gives you three missile cannons to defend them. Use the mouse to aim your counterattacks and destroy incoming missiles before they reach the ground. Aircraft, explosive drones, and evasive threats add to the attacks you need to intercept.

The game ends when every city has been destroyed. A bonus city is awarded for each 10,000 points, so protecting the remaining settlements and building your score can help extend the defense. Watch the different flight paths and choose where a counterattack will be most useful as the waves continue.

pages.title: Kids Hangman
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Kids Hangman is a word guessing game in which you try to uncover a hidden word before the drawing is completed. Choose letters using the mouse or the on-screen touch buttons, then use the revealed parts of the word to guide another guess. Keep track of what you have tried as you work out the missing letters and complete the word.

pages.title: Aliens Attack
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Aliens Attack is an arcade shooter about defending Earth from blue invaders from Mars. Join characters including Ramdo, Bernie, and Sgt. Pepper as they fight through the alien attack. Your machine gun fires automatically, leaving you to move from side to side and avoid enemy lasers. Keep adjusting your position while the gun attacks the invaders, balancing a clear firing position with a route away from the next incoming shot.

pages.title: Shoot the Asteroids
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Shoot the Asteroids puts you in a small triangular spacecraft surrounded by asteroids and enemy saucers. Navigate through the hazards and destroy targets to earn points, keeping track of the space around your ship as the field becomes dangerous. A teleport function can help you escape a difficult position. Combine movement, shooting, and well timed escapes as you work toward a higher score in its retro space setting.

pages.title: Wild Bull Shooter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Wild Bull Shooter is a hunting shooter about locating aggressive bulls and taking them down with a sniper weapon. Use the map to find your targets before they close in on you. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, use the right mouse button to zoom, and scroll to switch weapons. R reloads and Space jumps. Keep track of the bulls' positions while you line up your next shot.

pages.title: Racing Cars Jigsaw Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Racing Cars Jigsaw Challenge offers 12 racing car pictures to rebuild from puzzle pieces. Choose an image, then drag each piece back to its original position until the picture is complete. Compare the car details across the pieces as you work out where they belong. There is no time limit, so you can take your time arranging each image.

pages.title: Truck Loader Online Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Truck Loader Online Master is a 2D cargo loading game about putting boxes into their marked positions. Move the cargo around the loading area and place each box where the task requires it. The timer limits how long you have to finish, so consider the order of the boxes before moving them. Complete the current loading arrangement and continue through the remaining levels.

pages.title: Beat Corona Memory Game
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Beat Corona Memory Game uses pictures of people wearing masks in a card matching puzzle. Reveal the images with the mouse and look for a second card with the same picture. Matching pairs are removed, leaving fewer cards to search. Remember where each face appears so you can find its partner later, and clear the pairs to work through the levels.

pages.title: Drag Kart
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Drag Kart is a kart driving game about drifting around a track while staying on the road. Use the mouse or touch controls to guide the kart through the turns and keep the run going. Choose from four karts and work on your cornering as you try to improve your result. Watch the next bend before making your next steering adjustment.

pages.title: Monster Offroad Truck
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Monster Offroad Truck is a driving game about getting your vehicle to the finish line. Choose a vehicle, select a level, and use WASD or the arrow keys to guide it through the course. Keep the truck under control as you work toward the finish. Complete the current stage and take on another route from the level selection.

pages.title: LOL Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: LOL Spot the Difference is a picture comparison puzzle about finding five changes between two otherwise matching images. Look closely at the two scenes and click or tap a detail that differs. Keep checking the remaining parts of the pictures until you have found all five. The challenge is to notice small changes without overlooking the details that still match.

pages.title: Bulldozer Climb
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Bulldozer Climb is a platform jumping game about crossing hills before the timer expires. Choose a single or double jump with the left and right arrow keys, or use the mouse controls, to move the bulldozer through the terrain. Pick up clocks to add time and keep the attempt going. Watch the spacing of the hills as you try to travel farther before the countdown ends.

pages.title: Baby Doll House Cleaning
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Baby Doll House Cleaning is a cleaning game about tidying a home for a baby doll. Follow the on-screen instructions and work through the household cleaning activities, including the game's virus-removal tasks. Complete the jobs presented in the house and help get its rooms ready for the doll.

pages.title: Memory with Flags
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Memory with Flags is a card matching game about pairing the flags of the same country. One card shows the flag on its own, while its partner also displays the country's name. Click to reveal cards and remember their positions when you find a different pair. Clear all the matching country pairs to finish the board. Choose Easy, Normal, or Hard to change the challenge.

pages.title: Ball Picker 3D
pages.creator: Play.works
pages.description: Ball Picker 3D is a physics collection game about moving a scoop through groups of balls. Guide it from side to side to gather a load, then drop the balls into a pit. Collecting and delivering the balls earns coins that can unlock new skins. Use the left and right arrows, or click and move the mouse horizontally, to position the scoop and collect the balls along its route.

pages.title: Tricky bike stunt:Bike Game 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Tricky bike stunt:Bike Game 2020 is a motorcycle game about reaching the goal at the end of a difficult motocross level. Ride through the course and work past its obstacles as you aim for the finish. Each stage presents another riding challenge to complete. Judge your approach to the next section and keep working through the bike levels.

pages.title: Paper Block 2048
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paper Block 2048 is a puzzle about combining matching numbered tiles. Bring tiles showing the same number together to combine them into a higher value, working toward a 2048 tile. Consider where matching numbers are positioned before choosing your next move, and keep arranging the board to create further merges. Use the mouse or touch controls to play.

pages.title: Water Hop Chubby
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Water Hop Chubby is a timed platform hopping game about helping a child cross the water safely. The left arrow or a tap on the left makes a single-platform jump; the right arrow or a tap on the right skips across two platforms. Choose the jump length that fits the next part of the route and avoid falling into the water. Collect clocks along the way to add time and continue the crossing.

pages.title: Save the Miner
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Save the Miner is a removal puzzle about getting a stranded miner back to the ground safely. Click or tap the boxes beneath his feet to remove them and lower his position. Think about the support left in the stack before taking another box away, so the descent does not become dangerous. Choose the removals that bring the miner down unharmed.

pages.title: Fire Road
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fire Road is a survival game controlled with a single click or tap. Change gravity to guide your movement past the obstacles along the route, choosing the moment of each change carefully. Keep watching the next section of the path and adjust before an obstacle gets in the way. Try to carry the attempt farther and survive for a longer run.

pages.title: Ancient Egypt Spot The Differences
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Ancient Egypt Spot The Differences offers 20 picture comparison challenges set around ancient Egypt. Compare each pair of images and click or tap the details that do not match. Look across the whole scene so you do not miss a small change among the larger objects. Find all the changes in the current scene and continue through the remaining picture challenges.

pages.title: Xtrem Impossible Cargo Truck Simulator
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Xtrem Impossible Cargo Truck Simulator is a driving game focused on handling a large loaded truck through difficult turns. Use WASD to drive and keep the vehicle balanced as you steer its long body around the route. The cargo in the back can be damaged if the truck loses balance. Manage your speed and approach to each corner so you can keep both the truck and its load under control.

pages.title: TrollFace Quest: USA 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: TrollFace Quest: USA 1 is a point-and-click puzzle adventure built around American themed jokes and unexpected outcomes. Use the mouse to interact with each scene and look for the action that lets you progress. The puzzles are designed to be tricky, so experiment with the objects and watch how the scene responds. Work out the unusual solution to move on to another comic situation.

pages.title: Santa Claus Jumping Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Santa Claus Jumping Adventure is a platform game about collecting gifts while staying away from little red devils. Guide Santa's jumps around the scene and choose routes that bring him to more presents without meeting an enemy. Use the mouse or touch controls to play. There is no time limit, so concentrate on placing each jump as you gather the gifts.

pages.title: Easter Egg Bird
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Easter Egg Bird is a flapping arcade game about collecting Easter eggs while avoiding obstacles. Tap to give the bird a little lift, timing the taps to keep its flight path clear. Gathering enough eggs gives you access to Turbo power for a faster burst of flight. Keep balancing the next egg pickup against the obstacles ahead as you try to extend the run and raise your score.

pages.title: Underwater Cycling Adventure
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Underwater Cycling Adventure takes bicycle racing into an underwater setting. Guide your bike through the submerged environment and take on its cycling challenges among the fish. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, Shift for nitro, and C to change the camera. Adjust your view and movement as you work through the game's unusual underwater rides.

pages.title: Zoo Trivia
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Zoo Trivia tests your ability to recognize animals and spell their names. Look at the pictured animal, then fill its name with the correct letters, working from left to right. If you make a mistake, remove a letter and try a different spelling. The animal selection includes mammals, fish, and insects.

Each set contains five timed questions. Finish a set to earn stars and unlock the next one. Three kinds of hints are available when a picture or spelling leaves you stuck, giving you help as you work through more animals.

pages.title: Clash of Armour
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Clash of Armour is a real time tank strategy game about breaking through an opponent's defenses. Tap a card to deploy an armored unit, choosing when to send it into the battle. Each unit has strengths and weaknesses, so consider which one will help against the forces in front of you. Combine your deployment choices and timing to push toward the enemy defenses and destroy them.

pages.title: Rotate
pages.creator: Light Wolf Studios
pages.description:
Rotate is a puzzle platform adventure in a facility of test chambers where you can change the direction of gravity. Use that ability to find a route through each room as the intelligence running the facility reveals more about your purpose. Changing gravity alters how you can traverse the chamber, making the room's orientation part of the puzzle.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press Q or E to rotate, and use S or the down arrow to interact. P or Esc pauses the game while you consider another approach.

pages.title: Baby Cat Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Baby Cat Puzzle Time is a jigsaw game about rebuilding pictures of kittens. Put the separate pieces back into their original positions and match the picture details until the whole image is restored. Work through the remaining pieces as the cat picture takes shape. Use the mouse or touch controls to move the pieces and complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Planet Shot
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Planet Shot is an arcade defense game about protecting a planet from incoming asteroids. Move its moon around the planet to intercept the attacks before they hit the surface. Keep watching where the next asteroid is approaching and bring the moon into its path. Successful blocks build your score, while missed attacks damage the planet. Use the mouse controls and try to sustain the defense for a longer run.

pages.title: EG Little Broccoli
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Little Broccoli is an obstacle avoidance game starring a moving broccoli character. Click or touch to move it up and down, choosing a clear route around the obstacles. A collision ends the attempt, and the game gradually speeds up as you continue. Watch the next opening and adjust the broccoli's position before the path becomes blocked.

pages.title: Ultraman Planet Adventure
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Ultraman Planet Adventure is an action adventure about completing missions on a hostile planet. Guide Ultraman through the challenges, defeat the monsters, and make use of the props in the course as you work toward each objective. The game also supports a two-player adventure. Take on the planet's obstacles and keep progressing through the monster fighting missions.

pages.title: Hand Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Hand Skin Doctor is a medical treatment game about caring for a hand with skin problems. Use the virtual clinic tools to work through the on-screen tasks, including applying creams and looking after the nails. Follow the highlighted areas that need attention and complete the care activities as you progress through the treatment stages.

pages.title: Change The Color
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Change The Color is a two-color reaction game. Switch between black and white to catch items with the matching color and build your score. Keep checking the color you need next and time each switch to continue the matching sequence.

pages.title: Pixel Art
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Pixel Art is a coloring game in which numbered areas guide you through a pixel picture. Choose a design, such as an animal, building, pizza, or person, then apply the colors that correspond to its numbers. Work through the sections until the full image is colored. Completed pictures can be viewed in your works collection, letting you look back over the designs you have finished.

pages.title: Geometry Tower
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Geometry Tower is a stacking game about dropping items precisely onto a growing tower. Build with objects such as burgers or teddy bears and try to pile them into a tall, steady stack. Consider where the next item will land before releasing it, using each placement to support what comes after it. Keep adding to the tower and work on a higher build.

pages.title: Amigo Pancho
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Amigo Pancho is a physics puzzle about helping Pancho escape a dangerous canyon. Click objects to remove them and change the arrangement around him, opening a way through the obstacles. Some objects cannot be removed, so inspect what is available before making a change. Choose the removals that help Pancho through the canyon and consider how each one affects the remaining puzzle.

pages.title: Watermelon Arrow Scatter Game
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Watermelon Arrow Scatter Game is an arrow shooting challenge with watermelon targets. Aim and launch your arrows at the fruit, working through the shooting tasks across the game's levels.

pages.title: Color rush chalenge
pages.creator: mrseo88
pages.description: Color rush chalenge is a reaction game about matching falling geometric shapes to a sharp platform. Hold one of the number keys 1, 2, or 3 to change the platform's color. Make sure its color matches a shape at the moment they meet. Watch each approaching piece and switch to the right key as more shapes descend.

pages.title: Foosball
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Foosball brings table football to matches against the computer or a friend. Move the sticks with W and S, positioning the figures to block the ball and send it toward the other goal. Try to outscore the opposition while protecting your own end of the table. Choose Scrimmage or Championship mode and work on intercepting the ball before setting up another shot.

pages.title: Euro Football Pong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Euro Football Pong is a football themed ball game about defending your goal and scoring for your team. Use the mouse to get into position, block the opponent's ball, and send it back toward their end of the field. Keep watching the ball as you alternate between protecting your own goal and looking for a way past the opposition.

pages.title: Fairy Princess Dresser
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Fairy Princess Dresser is a makeover game about creating a colorful fairy look. Work on the princess's makeup, choose her outfit, and add accessories to complete the style. Explore different colors and clothing combinations as you put the look together. Finish the given styling tasks and coordinate the cosmetics, clothes, and details into the fairy princess design you want.

pages.title: Dolly Role Play Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Dolly Role Play Dress Up follows Tris and Dove as they try on costumes for an evening of role-playing. Open the boxes to discover dresses, shoes, and hairstyles, then combine the items into a character look. You can dress Tris as Jasmine or style Dove as Elsa. Experiment with the costume pieces and work toward completing the game's achievements as you create the outfits.

pages.title: Gingerbread Maker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Gingerbread Maker is a decorating puzzle about recreating a pictured cookie design. Check the reference, choose the right colors, and add frosting and toppings to make your gingerbread match it. Compare the details as you decorate so the finished cookie follows the example. Complete the design to finish the level and take on another gingerbread pattern.

pages.title: Ice Princess Fashion Day!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give the ice princess a new style in Ice Princess Fashion Day! Explore the outfit and makeup choices, then combine them into a look for her fashion day. Compare the available clothes and cosmetics as you decide what works together. Keep adjusting the selections until you have completed the princess's new appearance.
